notes: Set it to 48 V; 8 A is the recommended current.

name: M5Stack ToF4M unit (VL53L1X)
notes: Measures the lift's height for the pinch guard.

name: OpenArm bimanual arm set (two 7-DOF arms with grippers)
notes: Left and right, from OpenArm's certified seller. Each arm has its own CAN-FD bus. The robot uses the follower set; leader arms are a separate set.

name: Pibiger USB to dual-channel CAN FD converter
notes: Two CAN-FD channels, one per arm: up to 12 Mbit/s, isolated from USB to 2.5 kV.

name: MikroTik hAP ac3 router
notes: The robot's own network: the computer, the StamPLC, the head and the tablet.

name: RealSense D415 depth camera
notes: Optional. A depth camera for the head; the face tracker uses it. The Orbbec Femto Bolt is an alternative.

name: Orbbec Femto Bolt depth camera
notes: Optional. A time-of-flight depth camera; an alternative to the RealSense D415.

name: Raspberry Pi 5, 4 GB
notes: Optional, for shows. The box's computer. 4 GB is plenty. A Raspberry Pi 4 runs the same image and makes a good spare.

name: Raspberry Pi 27 W USB-C power supply
notes: Optional, for shows. The official supply for the Pi 5; a weaker one shows as an under-voltage warning on the stage page. A Pi 4 takes the official 15 W one.

name: Raspberry Pi Active Cooler (for Pi 5)
notes: Optional, for shows. Clips onto the Pi 5.

name: High-endurance microSD card, 32 GB or more
notes: Optional, for shows. Holds the system, which runs read-only. A high-endurance card is made for constant use.

name: Micro-HDMI to HDMI cable, short
notes: Optional, for shows. The Pi's HDMI ports are micro-HDMI. Use HDMI 0, the port nearest the USB-C power.

name: USB 3 flash drive, 32 GB or more
notes: Optional, for shows. The box's own copies of the show videos, so a show plays without Wi-Fi. The setup erases it. Plug it into a blue (USB 3) port.

name: Sabrent USB external stereo sound adapter
notes: Optional, for shows. Any class-compliant USB audio adapter works. Sends the show's music to a powered speaker instead of the screen.

name: 3.5 mm stereo audio cable
notes: Optional, for shows. From the USB audio adapter to a powered speaker's aux input.

name: 3.5 mm ground-loop isolator
notes: Optional, for shows. Only if the speaker hums. Fits inline on the audio cable.

name: Femto Bolt mount, 30° or straight (3D-printed)
notes: A sleeve around the camera with two legs that drop into the face holder's pockets. The 30° mount tilts the camera down and is the default; the straight one holds it square. PLA or PETG, 15% infill; STL and 3MF in hardware/ TBD.

name: M4 x 16 mm bolt with a nut or threaded insert
notes: One through each pocket of the face holder and the leg inside it (4.3 mm hole). A pin that stops the leg sliding out; the pocket's fit holds the mount.

name: Camera retaining screw (size TBD)
notes: Through the small holes in the sleeve's side walls, two a side, to hold the camera in. Size and length to be confirmed.
